title: '57,000 migrants at risk: Time to end whipping in Malaysia
body: 'Malaysians Against Death Penalty and Torture (Madpet) calls for the abolition of whipping, a form of corporal punishment that is inherently cruel, inhumane and degrading and often amounts to torture. In Malaysia, it has even caused death. Physical trauma Judicial whipping, commonly known as caning in Malaysia, is carried out using a heavy rattan cane on a prisoner’s bare buttocks under strict legal and medical supervision. The offender is stripped and made to lean forward against a specialised wooden or padded frame, with their hands and legs securely shackled. Comparatively, Sharia caning is a lighter, symbolic or non-scarring form of corporal punishment focused on religious deterrence and public repentance rather than severe physical trauma. The offender is typically clothed. In many cases, the person being whipped faints after several strokes. It can also result in death, as happened in the case of Zaidi Abd Hamid, who passed away on 7 October 2025 in Pokok Sena prison at the age of 49 after receiving a sentence of 12 strokes of the cane (whipping). An investigation by the Malaysian human rights commission Suhakam confirmed that before he died, Zaidi’s whipping wounds became infected, and he did not receive proper medical care. It is sad that Zaidi, whose death penalty was recently commuted, ultimately died after receiving his alternative sentence of whipping. - Sign up for Aliran's free daily email updates or weekly newsletters or both - Make a one-off donation to Persatuan Aliran Kesedaran Negara (ALIRAN), Maybank a/c 507246118995 or CIMB a/c 8004240948 - Make a regular pledge or periodic auto-donation to Aliran - Become an Aliran member Towards abolition of whipping We appreciate that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s Pakatan Harapan government is still actively considering the abolition of whipping in Malaysia. On mandatory caning, Kulasegaran, the deputy law and institutional reform minister, said the issue was still under consultation following a recent meeting he chaired on a study into its impact and effectiveness in Malaysia. He said discussions with the Attorney General’s Chambers and other relevant parties were ongoing. It must be noted that, since the Immigration Act was amended in August 2002 to include whipping as a sentence for those found to be in Malaysia without proper documents, the majority of those being whipped are undocumented foreigners. This may also sadly have included refugees, asylum seekers and human trafficking victims. For the offence of illegally being in Malaysia, section 6(3) of the Immigration Act 1959/63 states: Any person who contravenes subsection (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding ten thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or to both, and shall also be liable to whipping of not more than six strokes. According to Prisons Department records, 47,914 foreigners were found to have violated the Immigration Act from 2002 to 2008. Of these, 34,923 were caned or whipped. There are no current records provided by the government, but it is estimated that about 5,000 to 10,000 are still being whipped in Malaysia annually. Media reports prove that whipping has failed to deter illegal presence in Malaysia. Sabri’s gross miscarriage of justice came to light because his trade union and civil society groups raised it, and the media covered it. Foreigners who are victims of human trafficking cannot be charged for the crime of illegally being in Malaysia. Did the prosecution or the courts even take this into consideration? Did they confirm that the accused is not a victim of human trafficking or do they simply not bother – and convict and sentence them to be whipped? Section 25 of the Anti-Trafficking in Persons and Anti-Smuggling of Migrants Act 2007 (Atipsom), which deals with immunity from criminal prosecution, states: A trafficked person shall not be liable to criminal prosecution in respect of: (a) his illegal entry into the receiving country or transit country; (b) his period of unlawful residence in the receiving country or transit country; or (c) his procurement or possession of any fraudulent travel or identity document which he obtained, or with which he was supplied, for the purpose of entering the receiving country or transit country, where such acts are the direct consequence of an act of trafficking in persons that is alleged to have been committed or was committed. It is most important for the prosecution or the courts to determine how the foreigner came to be in Malaysia. Was it due to deception, etc? If the foreigner was once a registered migrant worker, suspicion should naturally arise over why he or she is still in Malaysia, since our law places the burden on employers to send them back to their country of origin. If the worker is still here because he or she has been cheated of the wages promised, then reasonably he or she is also a victim of human trafficking, as ‘trafficking in persons’ means all actions of recruiting, conveying, transferring, acquiring, maintaining, harbouring, providing or receiving, a person, for the purpose of exploitation. Thus, workers brought to Malaysia on a promise of work and certain wages, who then end up with different jobs and wages, are clearly victims of human trafficking. The same applies to workers whom employers still have not paid the wages and money due. These refugees and asylum seekers also cannot be held in detention for being illegally in Malaysia. Reasonably, they cannot also be convicted for the crime of illegally being in Malaysia, as a conviction also may result in a sentence of whipping. Therefore, whipping must be abolished now, and, pending abolition, the Malaysian government must impose a moratorium on whipping. Even documented migrants can be wrongfully whipped because of the fault or negligence of the authorities, the prosecution and the courts, as happened in Sabri Umar’s case. Gross injustice can also be suffered by victims of human trafficking because of the failure of the prosecution or the courts to consider whether section 25 of Atipsom will be violated. Likewise, refugees and asylum seekers may also end up being wrongly whipped. In Malaysia this year alone, 57,161 undocumented migrants were detained in various enforcement operations nationwide between 1 January and 13 September. This means most of these 57,000 are at serious risk of being convicted and whipped. This alone makes the abolition of whipping a priority that needs urgent action by the Malaysian government. As such, Madpet calls for the immediate abolition of whipping and, pending abolition, a moratorium on whipping to avoid the innocent, including victims of human trafficking and refugees or asylum seekers, from being wrongly and unjustly whipped. Madpet calls for the repeal of section 6(4) of the Immigration Act, which now removes the onus or duty of the prosecution or the courts to determine whether the foreign national is a victim of human trafficking or not, or whether he or she is a refugee or asylum seeker who also should not be criminally liable for illegally being in Malaysia. title: 'DNB lengkapkan pembiayaan RM5.2 bilion bagi menyokong fasa seterusnya pertumbuhan 5G - Newswav
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 1 Okt - Digital Nasional Bhd (DNB) melengkapkan pembiayaan berjangka Islam secara sindiket bernilai RM5.2 bilion, sekali gus mengukuhkan kedudukan pembiayaan jangka panjang syarikat ketika Malaysia memasuki fasa pertumbuhan seterusnya dwirangkaian 5G . DNB dalam kenyataan berkata pembiayaan itu akan memudahkan perancangan keluar Menteri Kewangan Diperbadankan (MOF Inc) sebagai pemegang saham biasa dan peralihan kepada pemilikan sama rata dalam kalangan pemegang saham pengendali rangkaian mudah alihnya, iaitu CelcomDigi Bhd, Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd dan YTL Power International Bhd. Peralihan pemilikan tersebut dijangka berlaku pada awal suku keempat 2026, manakala MOF Inc akan mengekalkan saham khas dalam DNB bagi melindungi kepentingan negara. Pembiayaan berkenaan turut merangkumi pembiayaan semula kemudahan kredit pusingan DNB yang dijamin kerajaan dan tamat tempoh pada 29 September, selain mewujudkan struktur pembiayaan jangka panjang bagi menyokong pertumbuhan syarikat. Penyempurnaan pembiayaan itu bertepatan dengan pemberian penuh spektrum 100MHz dalam jalur 3.3–3.4GHz serta penukaran keseluruhan pegangan spektrum 240MHz DNB kepada penetapan spektrum. Penetapan oleh Suruhanjaya Komunikasi dan Multimedia Malaysia (MCMC) itu berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Oktober. Menurut DNB, blok spektrum 240MHz tersebut akan meningkatkan kapasiti, kecekapan dan prestasi rangkaian, selain menyokong teknologi termasuk Massive MIMO, pengagregatan pembawa, 5G Advanced dan keupayaan rangkaian dipacu kecerdasan buatan. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif DNB, Datuk Azman Ismail berkata pembiayaan berkenaan menyediakan platform mampan untuk syarikat beroperasi secara bebas sambil meneruskan pelaburan dalam peningkatan rangkaian dan peluasan kapasiti. “Penyempurnaan pembiayaan RM5.2 bilion ini merupakan pencapaian penting bagi DNB dan mencerminkan keyakinan kukuh terhadap asas perniagaan, rekod operasi serta peranan jangka panjang kami dalam ekonomi digital Malaysia,” katanya. Maybank Investment Bank Bhd bertindak sebagai pengatur utama yang diberi mandat, pengurus buku dan pengatur penyelaras bagi pembiayaan itu. AmInvestment Bank Bhd, CIMB Islamic Bank Bhd, RHB Islamic Bank Bhd dan United Overseas Bank (Malaysia) Bhd pula merupakan pengatur utama bersama yang diberi mandat, manakala AmInvestment Bank bertindak sebagai penasihat kewangan DNB. - DagangNews.com

title: 'Customary land: Between Orang Asli rights and the law
body: 'The sultan of Pahang has called for greater clarity over the use of the term tanah adat (customary land), saying Orang Asli land claims must be assessed according to the legal status of the land, including its gazetting, boundaries and history of occupation. However, for Orang Asli communities, the issue goes beyond what is written on a land title. So, where does customary land sit within Malaysian law? And what happens when customary claims meet the state’s gazetting process? Astro Awani’s Melisa Idris speaks with Bah Tony, the deputy chairperson of the Bar Council’s committee on Orang Asli rights, and Ismail Leh, a Pahang representative from Jaringan Kampung Orang Asli Semenanjung Malaysia (JKOASM). title: 'Bursa opens lower on higher US yields, Middle East tensions
body: 'At 9.10am, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) eased 3.74 points, or 0.22%, to 1,647.43 from Wednesday’s close of 1,651.17. The index opened 1.30 points lower at 1,649.87. On the broader market, decliners outpaced gainers 200 to 142, with 307 counters unchanged, 2,124 untraded and 12 suspended. Turnover stood at 246.59 million shares worth RM118.14 million. Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd vice-president of equity research Thong Pak Leng said Wall Street closed mixed as softer inflation eased expectations of another US Federal Reserve rate hike, although elevated bond yields continued to weigh on sentiment. On the domestic front, he said the market benchmark may trade cautiously, with weak market breadth and recent foreign selling indicating continued caution among investors. “Thus, for today, we expect the index to remain in consolidation mode within the 1,640-1,660 range, with bargain hunting providing some downside support,” he told Bernama. Among the heavyweights, Maybank and IHH Healthcare were unchanged at RM9.90 and RM7.83 respectively. Public Bank fell three sen to RM4.67, CIMB shed one sen to RM7.78 and Tenaga Nasional lost two sen to RM12.94. In active trade, ACE Market debutant GB Bond fell half a sen to 24.5 sen, while VS Industry was unchanged at 28 sen. Astro Malaysia added half a sen to six sen, Jaks Resources gained one sen to 21.5 sen and Divfex advanced two sen to 11 sen. Among the top gainers, Keck Seng advanced 11 sen to RM5.14 and Petron Malaysia rose seven sen to RM3.47. Hengyuan Refining and Spritzer each gained six sen to RM3.62 and RM3.67 respectively, while Jati Tinggi strengthened five sen to RM1.44. Kuala Lumpur Kepong led the decliners, falling 18 sen to RM22.02. UWC shed 15 sen to RM6.92, while Insights Analytics and MISC each fell nine sen to RM1.20 and RM7.55 respectively. Petronas Dagangan lost eight sen to RM19.20. On the index board, the FBM Mid 70 Index fell 42.26 points to 17,532.41, the FBM Emas Index declined 26.32 points to 12,265.69, and the FBM Top 100 Index shed 27.82 points to 12,056.62. The FBM Emas Shariah Index weakened 22.09 points to 12,154.26, while the FBM ACE Index trimmed 6.31 points to 5,527.97. Sector-wise, the Industrial Products and Services Index slipped 0.10 point to 180.31, while the Energy Index gained 1.41 points to 847.11. The Financial Services Index fell 27.47 points to 19,189.02, while the Plantation Index retreated 33.34 points to 9,163.33.

title: 'Mateen perlu RM8,000 beli ‘stroller’ khas
body: 'PETALING JAYA – Bayi hidrosefalus, Muhammad Mateen Aryan Muhammad Hanif, 15 bulan, dari Sungai Petani, Kedah, kini semakin aktif namun pergerakannya terbatas disebabkan kepalanya yang berat. Bapanya, Muhammad Hanif Zakaria, 32, berkata, Mateen kini cuba menggerakkan badan dan memusingkan badan, tetapi sukar berbuat demikian dengan kepala yang mencecah ukuran 90 sentimeter (cm). “Perkembangan dia okey. Dia pun cuba bergerak, nak pusing badannya, tetapi tak boleh sebab kepala dia berat,” katanya ketika dihubungi Kosmo!. Menurut Muhammad Hanif, keadaan Mateen kini semakin baik apabila sawan yang dialaminya semakin berkurang, namun apabila serangan berlaku, saiz kepala anaknya boleh kembali membesar. “Sejak kami mendapatkan rawatan alternatif, Mateen semakin kurang diserang sawan dan saiz kepala dia turun sedikit ke 89cm. Tapi apabila kena sawan, automatik saiz tu boleh naik balik,” ujarnya. Muhammad Hanif berkata, keperluan asas Matten kini mencukupi dan berterima kasih kepada pihak yang pernah membantu, namun dia dan isteri kini merancang untuk mendapatkan kereta sorong (stroller) khas bagi memudahkan pergerakan Mateen. Bagaimanapun dia menjelaskan, ia perlu ditempah khas mengikut keperluan Mateen, dengan anggaran kos sebanyak RM8,000 dan akan berbuat demikian apabila jumlah itu mencukupi. Orang ramai yang ingin membantu keluarga itu mendapatkan kereta sorong berkenaan, boleh menyalurkan sumbangan ke akaun bank CIMB bernombor 7632966954 di atas nama Muhammad Hanif. Terdahulu Kosmo! melaporkan, Muhammad Hanif yang bekerja sebagai pemandu lori bersyukur kerana anak bongsu daripada tiga beradik itu tidak pernah menangis kesakitan sejak lahir. Dia dan isteri, Habidah Nasruddin, 31, bagaimanapun berdepan kesukaran mengangkat Mateen disebabkan kepalanya yang makin membesar.

title: 'Bursa Malaysia Midday Losses Continue Amid Selling Pressure
body: 'Kuala Lumpur:Bursa Malaysia extended its downtrend at midday, influenced by selling pressure and a mixed global market performance, as risk sentiment remained restrained by the continuous rise in United States Treasury yields. According to BERNAMA News Agency, at 12.30 pm, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) dropped 15.36 points to 1,635.81 from the previous day's close of 1,651.17. The benchmark index opened 1.30 points lower at 1,649.87 and ranged between 1,634.39 and 1,649.87 during the morning session. On the broader market, decliners outnumbered gainers by 583 to 305, with 464 counters unchanged, 1,421 untraded, and 12 suspended. The turnover was 1.65 billion shares worth RM1.18 billion. Apex Securities Bhd noted that market sentiment was further dampened by stronger-than-expected US private-sector hiring, which increased by 90,000 in September. This situation offset the relief from softer core Personal Consumption Expenditures inflation. Investors are now looking towards the upcoming September non-farm payrolls for guidance on the US Federal Reserve's next steps, while stalled US-Iran negotiations keep oil prices volatile, and mainland Chinese markets remain closed for the Golden Week holiday. The stockbroking firm anticipates that the FBM KLCI will trade cautiously ahead of the US jobs data report, with a more sustained recovery contingent on a pullback in US bond yields and progress in US-Iran talks. Among the heavyweights, Maybank and Tenaga Nasional both decreased by six sen to RM9.93 and RM12.90, respectively. Public Bank lost four sen to RM4.66, CIMB fell five sen to RM7.74, and IHH Healthcare declined 19 sen to RM7.64. In active trading, Zetrix AI and V.S Industry both rose half a sen to 16.5 sen and 28.5 sen, respectively. Jaks Resources decreased half a sen to 20 sen, ACE Market debutant GB Bond fell 2.5 sen to 22.5 sen, and Dagang Nexchange increased 1.5 sen to 50 sen. Among the top gainers, Malaysian Pacific Industries advanced RM1.26 to RM41.66, MI Technovation rose 13 sen to RM5.33, Ta Ann gained 12 sen to RM5.92, Malayan Cement increased 11 sen to RM5.56, and Genting Plantations improved 10 sen to RM5.63. Kuala Lumpur Kepong led the decliners, dropping 76 sen to RM21.44. Allianz Malaysia shed 62 sen to RM21, while Fraser and Neave, Hong Leong Industries, and Batu Kawan all fell 42 sen to RM21.32, RM16.04, and RM20.10, respectively. On the index board, the FBM Mid 70 Index fell 87.65 points to 17,487.02, the FBM Emas Index declined 94.18 points to 12,197.83, and the FBM Top 100 Index lost 99.00 points to 11,985.44. The FBM Emas Shariah Index weakened 87.69 points to 12,088.65, while the FBM ACE Index contracted 31.14 points to 5,503.14. In sectoral performance, the Industrial Products and Services Index slipped 1.16 points to 178.80, the Energy Index eased 7.79 points to 837.91, the Financial Services Index fell 148.77 points to 19,067.72, and the Plantation Index retreated 121.85 points to 9,074.82.

title: 'FBM KLCI Rebounds at Midday, Driven by Utilities Stocks
body: 'Kuala Lumpur:The FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) saw a rebound at midday, gaining 10.18 points to reach 1,654.14, up from Tuesday's close of 1,643.96, driven by bargain hunting in selected heavyweight stocks, particularly in the utilities sector, although overall market breadth remained negative. According to BERNAMA News Agency, the index opened 2.53 points higher at 1,646.49 and moved within a range of 1,645.03 to 1,656.87 during the session. Utilities stocks were at the forefront of the gains, with Tenaga Nasional increasing by 32 sen to RM13.04, Petronas Gas rising by 20 sen to RM17.38, and YTL Corporation edging up by one sen to RM2.30. Despite the gains in the index, the broader market witnessed decliners outnumbering gainers by 603 to 350, with 521 counters remaining unchanged, 1,381 untraded, and 95 suspended. The turnover amounted to 1.92 billion shares valued at RM1.49 billion. Apex Securities Bhd noted in a statement that the energy sector, one of the only two sectors to gain, might experience a reversal of some gains following a dip in Brent crude oil prices overnight amid ongoing US-Iran talks. At the time of reporting, Brent crude had risen by 0.48 percent to US$103.08 per barrel. In terms of heavyweight stocks, Maybank increased by five sen to RM10.04, while Public Bank decreased by two sen to RM4.70. CIMB added one sen to RM7.79, and IHH Healthcare rose by three sen to RM7.90. Among active traders, Zetrix AI remained flat at 16.5 sen, V.S Industry increased by 1.5 sen to 25 sen, and Gamuda recovered by 20 sen to RM5.18. Jaks Resources and Tanco each rose by half a sen to 19.5 sen and 16.5 sen, respectively. Top gainers included Nestle, which rose by RM1.20 to RM90.12, United Plantations, which gained 28 sen to RM31.60, and UMS Integration, which added 20 sen to RM8.81. Ayer edged up by 18 sen to RM7.78, and Allianz Malaysia advanced by 14 sen to RM21. Hengyuan Refining led the decliners, falling by 57 sen to RM3.77, and its trading was suspended for the remainder of the day after breaching the prescribed price limit. Malaysian Pacific Industries dropped by 44 sen to RM40.36, Eurospan by 25 sen to RM2.99, Kuala Lumpur Kepong by 22 sen to RM22.28, and MI Technovation by 17 sen to RM5.22. On the index board, the FBM Mid 70 Index decreased by 48.14 points to 17,561.95. In contrast, the FBM Emas Index rose by 40.32 points to 12,305.79, and the FBM Top 100 Index gained 46.83 points to 12,098.37. The FBM Emas Shariah Index increased by 69.56 points to 12,197.17, while the FBM ACE Index fell by 33.86 points to 5,494.72. Sector-wise, the Industrial Products and Services Index saw a slight rise of 0.32 points to 181.18. However, the Energy Index fell by 18.32 points to 850.38. Meanwhile, the Financial Services Index gained 10.75 points to 19,271.60, and the Plantation Index added 16.55 points, reaching 9,232.89.

title: 'Lindung 24 Perkeso tidak jejaskan industri insurans secara ketara — CIMB Securities
body: 'Lindung 24 Perkeso tidak jejaskan industri insurans secara ketara — CIMB Securities johardy 29/09/2026 - 09:00 Oleh JOHARDY IBRAHIM editor@dagangnews.com  KUALA LUMPUR 29 Sept - Skim Lindung 24 Pertubuhan Keselamatan Sosial (Perkeso) dijangka meluaskan perlindungan kemalangan kepada pekerja tanpa menjejaskan industri insurans dan takaful swasta secara ketara, menurut CIMB Securities.  Skim yang berkuat kuasa pada 1 Jun 2026 itu memberi perlindungan kepada pekerja yang layak bagi kemalangan yang tidak berkaitan dengan pekerjaan, termasuk ketika berada di rumah, melakukan perjalanan peribadi atau menyertai aktiviti riadah. Ia melengkapi Skim Bencana Pekerjaan Perkeso yang melindungi pekerja bagi kemalangan berkaitan kerja.  Menurut firma penyelidikan itu, Lindung 24 terutamanya memberi manfaat kepada pekerja yang kurang mendapat perlindungan, manakala insurans perubatan, hayat dan hilang upaya swasta masih mempunyai peranan tersendiri.  Memetik Perkeso, firma itu berkata kira-kira 48% rakyat Malaysia mempunyai perlindungan insurans selain insurans motor. Dalam kalangan kumpulan berpendapatan 40% terendah (B40), kadar perlindungan dianggarkan hanya 4%.

title: 'BERNAMA - Malaysia Entering More Supportive Water Investment Cycle  -- CIMB Securities
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR, Sept 28 (Bernama) -- Malaysia is entering a more supportive water investment cycle as ageing infrastructure, high water losses and rising industrial and data centre demand, as well as greater climate variability are increasing the urgency to improve water efficiency, reliability, and resilience. In a note today, CIMB Securities said the federal government had approved RM1.7 billion under the 13th Malaysia Plan to replace about 1,800 kilometres of critical pipes from 2026 to 2030, alongside a multi-year National Non-Revenue Water (NRW) Programme. It said sizeable projects including Langat 2 Phase 2, Rasau Phase 2, and the Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme should further strengthen water security and provide a visible pipeline for contractors, pipe manufacturers and ancillary solution providers. CIMB Securities said Malaysia’s NRW rate stood at 37.1 per cent in 2024. “Persistently high NRW, ageing distribution networks, and rising climate variability result in unnecessary raw water extraction, higher treatment and pumping requirements, weaker utility economics, and supply disruption risks. “Concurrently, population growth, industrialisation, and rapid data centre development are driving structural water demand, particularly across economic corridors in Selangor, Johor, and Penang,” it added. The stockbroking company said Malaysia’s water transition is seen broadening from purely building new infrastructure towards using existing water resources and assets more efficiently. It said sustainable NRW reduction requires physical rehabilitation alongside smart metering, leak detection, pressure management, telemetry, analytics, and intelligent asset-management systems. “These technologies can make water networks more visible, measurable, and manageable, improving the effectiveness of every ringgit spent on water infrastructure. “This is aligned with the Water Sector Transformation 2040 (WST2040), which promotes digitalisation, climate resilience, integrated water-resource management, and stronger sector governance,” it said. From an investment perspective, CIMB Securities said it favours companies positioned at either the efficiency or infrastructure-enablement layers of Malaysia’s water transition. “Insight Analytics Bhd is among the most direct listed proxies to water digitalisation and NRW management, while Gamuda Bhd offers exposure to large-scale treatment, transmission, and water security projects. “The key near-term risk remains the pace at which funding and policy commitments translate into tenders, project awards, and, ultimately, earnings,” it said. -- BERNAMA BERNAMA provides up-to-date authentic and comprehensive news and information which are disseminated via BERNAMA Wires; www.bernama.com; BERNAMA TV on Astro 502, unifi TV 631 and MYTV 121 channels and BERNAMA Radio on FM93.9 (Klang Valley), FM107.5 (Johor Bahru), FM107.9 (Kota Kinabalu) and FM100.9 (Kuching) frequencies. title: 'Markets brace for tighter Fed path: CIMB Securities
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Financial markets are pricing a more hawkish US Federal Reserve interest rate path than the latest forecasts from policymakers and economists: This could keep the US dollar supported into 2027, according to CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd. The firm said markets are pricing about 80 basis points of additional Fed tightening in 2027, equivalent to roughly 3.2 rate hikes. This is in comparison with the latest Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) projections for a 25-basis-point increase in the fourth quarter of 2026 and no further hikes in 2027. The FOMC's latest projection puts the policy rate at 4.25 per cent after the expected fourth-quarter move. CIMB Securities said market forecasts for end-2027 rates remain widely dispersed, ranging from 3.25 per cent to 4.50 per cent, with a median of 3.50 per cent. The firm said near-term upside risks to global energy prices and potential price shocks could keep markets positioned for tighter US monetary policy in the fourth quarter of 2026. It also revised higher its forecasts for US Treasury yields relative to German and Japanese government bonds. CIMB Securities raised its end-2027 two-year US Treasury-Bund and US Treasury-JGB spread assumptions by eight basis points and 15 basis points to about 160 basis points and 270 basis points respectively. The wider yield advantage is expected to support the dollar and reduce the case for sustained appreciation in the euro and yen. CIMB Securities said a return of Brent crude to US$100 a barrel could provide another source of support for the dollar, particularly as higher energy prices tend to weigh on currencies of major energy importers. The firm retained its near-term US Dollar Index (DXY) forecast at 101 but raised the third-quarter 2027 projection to 100. However, a decline in Brent below US$90 a barrel could reduce that support, with the DXY ceiling estimated at 99.8 under a lower oil-price scenario. For Asian currencies, CIMB Securities said the impact of higher US rates could be partly offset by relatively stable Chinese yuan conditions and higher regional yields. It expects Asian currencies to remain within their 12-month forecast ranges, with potential yuan strength ahead of a China-US summit providing some stability for the ringgit, Singapore dollar and Thai baht. Higher oil prices and US rates pose greater near-term risks to the Indonesian rupiah, they said, potentially adding pressure for a 25-basis-point Bank Indonesia rate hike in the fourth quarter of 2026.

'Markets brace for tighter Fed path: CIMB Securities

'KUALA LUMPUR: Financial markets are pricing a more hawkish US Federal Reserve interest rate path than the latest forecasts from policymakers and economists: This could keep the US dollar supported into 2027, according to CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd. The firm said markets are pricing about 80 basis points of additional Fed tightening in 2027, equivalent to roughly 3.2 rate hikes. This is in comparison with the latest Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) projections for a 25-basis-point increase in the fourth quarter of 2026 and no further hikes in 2027. The FOMC's latest projection puts the policy rate at 4.25 per cent after the expected fourth-quarter move. CIMB Securities said market forecasts for end-2027 rates remain widely dispersed, ranging from 3.25 per cent to 4.50 per cent, with a median of 3.50 per cent. The firm said near-term upside risks to global energy prices and potential price shocks could keep markets positioned for tighter US monetary policy in the fourth quarter of 2026. It also revised higher its forecasts for US Treasury yields relative to German and Japanese government bonds. CIMB Securities raised its end-2027 two-year US Treasury-Bund and US Treasury-JGB spread assumptions by eight basis points and 15 basis points to about 160 basis points and 270 basis points respectively. The wider yield advantage is expected to support the dollar and reduce the case for sustained appreciation in the euro and yen. CIMB Securities said a return of Brent crude to US$100 a barrel could provide another source of support for the dollar, particularly as higher energy prices tend to weigh on currencies of major energy importers. The firm retained its near-term US Dollar Index (DXY) forecast at 101 but raised the third-quarter 2027 projection to 100. However, a decline in Brent below US$90 a barrel could reduce that support, with the DXY ceiling estimated at 99.8 under a lower oil-price scenario. For Asian currencies, CIMB Securities said the impact of higher US rates could be partly offset by relatively stable Chinese yuan conditions and higher regional yields. It expects Asian currencies to remain within their 12-month forecast ranges, with potential yuan strength ahead of a China-US summit providing some stability for the ringgit, Singapore dollar and Thai baht. Higher oil prices and US rates pose greater near-term risks to the Indonesian rupiah, they said, potentially adding pressure for a 25-basis-point Bank Indonesia rate hike in the fourth quarter of 2026.

title: 'CIMB raih tiga anugerah perbankan Euromoney 2026
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: CIMB Bank Berhad dan CIMB Investment Bank (CIMB) terus mengukuhkan kedudukan dalam industri kewangan apabila meraih tiga anugerah utama pada Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2026. CIMB dinobatkan sebagai Bank Runcit Terbaik Malaysia, Bank Digital Terbaik Malaysia untuk Perusahaan Kecil dan Sederhana (PKS) serta Bank Pelaburan Terbaik Malaysia. Pengiktirafan berkenaan mencerminkan prestasi, inovasi dan impak kepada pelanggan yang dicapai CIMB, selain usaha berterusannya dalam menyediakan penyelesaian kewangan berorientasikan pelanggan menerusi inovasi, keupayaan digital dan kepakaran pasaran yang kukuh. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan CIMB, Novan Amirudin berkata, kejayaan itu membuktikan kepercayaan pelanggan serta komitmen pasukan bank dalam memenuhi keperluan individu dan perniagaan. “Pengiktirafan ini adalah bukti kepercayaan pelanggan serta dedikasi pasukan kami di seluruh bank. “Ia mengukuhkan semula tujuan CIMB untuk memacu kemajuan pelanggan dan masyarakat dengan menjadikan penyelesaian kewangan lebih mudah diakses, relevan dan memberi impak kepada individu serta perniagaan yang kami berkhidmat,” katanya dalam kenyataan. Menurut beliau, CIMB akan terus menjadi rakan kongsi dipercayai dalam membantu individu merealisasikan aspirasi mereka, selain menyokong perniagaan mencapai matlamat pertumbuhan melalui penciptaan nilai yang bermakna dan berkekalan. Dalam perbankan runcit, CIMB terus memperkukuh segmen perniagaannya menerusi penawaran diperibadikan, pengalaman digital serta penglibatan lebih kukuh dengan kumpulan pelanggan utama. Prestasi pendapatan dan keuntungan turut meningkat sepanjang tahun, disokong pertambahan bahagian pasaran dalam pembiayaan kenderaan, kad kredit dan deposit runcit, selain peningkatan jualan digital serta penawaran silang kepada pelanggan. CIMB turut memperkukuh penawaran pengurusan kekayaan menerusi penyelesaian pelaburan yang berbeza, kepelbagaian produk lebih luas, khidmat nasihat diketuai Ketua Pegawai Pelaburan (CIO) serta platform pengurusan kekayaan digital yang dipertingkatkan. Momentum itu khususnya ketara dalam segmen Preferred, mencerminkan penglibatan lebih mendalam dengan pelanggan berkemampuan tinggi serta tumpuan bank terhadap khidmat nasihat dan hubungan pelanggan dalam pengurusan kekayaan. Bagi segmen PKS pula, CIMB terus memperluas perbankan digital menerusi pelancaran CIMB OCTO Biz, yang menghubungkan pembukaan akaun, pembiayaan dan perbankan transaksi dalam satu perjalanan digital hujung ke hujung. Platform itu telah menarik lebih 280,000 pelanggan setakat ini, dengan menawarkan kemudahan melihat aliran tunai secara masa nyata, pembayaran, pertukaran asing, perdagangan serta perkhidmatan pembiayaan. Bank turut memperluas akses pembiayaan menerusi kemudahan pembiayaan pedagang bersepadu dengan TNG eWallet, selain pembiayaan fleksibel melalui SME FlexiCash. Kemudahan berkenaan menggunakan rekod sejarah akaun dan corak transaksi untuk menentukan had pra-kelayakan serta menghubungkan pembayaran balik kepada sebahagian daripada hasil perniagaan, sekali gus membantu perniagaan yang mempunyai aliran tunai tidak sekata. Sementara itu, kepimpinan CIMB Investment Bank dalam pasaran modal ekuiti dan hutang Malaysia, penggabungan dan pengambilalihan (M&A), serta penyelesaian nasihat kewangan khusus turut mengukuhkan kedudukannya sebagai bank pelaburan utama. Pada 2025, CIMB Investment Bank menduduki tempat pertama dalam pasaran modal ekuiti dan hutang Malaysia berdasarkan nilai urus niaga serta bahagian dompet (share of wallet). Bank itu turut menduduki kedudukan teratas dalam pasaran modal ekuiti dan hutang ASEAN berdasarkan nilai urus niaga, dengan kejayaan melaksanakan transaksi rentas sempadan yang mengukuhkan kedudukannya sebagai peneraju M&A dan khidmat nasihat di rantau ASEAN. Tiga anugerah berkenaan turut mengukuhkan janji jenama CIMB, Moving You Forward, yang mencerminkan komitmen berterusan bank dalam memperkasa pelanggan dan komuniti menerusi penyelesaian kewangan yang mudah diakses, inklusif serta berteraskan tujuan. Euromoney Awards for Excellence, yang telah berlangsung lebih 30 tahun, mengiktiraf institusi kewangan yang menetapkan penanda aras global dari segi prestasi, inovasi dan impak kepada pelanggan. Program anugerah itu menilai institusi kewangan menerusi rangka kerja penanda aras Euromoney dengan menggunakan metrik yang boleh dibandingkan, penyerahan maklumat berstruktur serta proses penyelidikan telus bagi menilai prestasi institusi berbanding pesaing masing-masing.-UTUSAN

title: 'MyDebit CIMB bakal mengalami gangguan sementara pada 19, 22 dan 23 Septmber 2026
body: 'Perkhidmatan MyDebit CIMB bakal mengalami gangguan sementara berikutan kerja-kerja penyelenggaraan sistem berjadual. Gangguan tersebut bakal menjejaskan pengguna CIMB Bank Berhad dan CIMB Islamic Bank Berhad. Selain itu, semua pembelian menggunakan Kad Debit melalui MyDebit, Visa dan Mastercard secara fizikal atau dalam talian akan terjejas semasa waktu penyelenggaraan. Melalui jadual yang dikongsi, gangguan tersebut akan bermula pada Sabtu, 19 September 2026, jam 12 tengah malam hingga 6 pagi, Selasa, 22 September 2026, jam 12 tengah malam hingga 7.30 pagi dan Rabu, 23 September 2026, jam 12 tengah malam hingga 5.00 pagi. Tujuan penyelenggaraan ini dibuat untuk memberikan pengalaman penggunaan yang lebih baik pada masa akan datang. Bagi mengelakkan sebarang gangguan, CIMB menyarankan pengguna untuk merancang perbelanjaan lebih awal.

title: 'Sektor teknologi dan industri jadi tumpuan selepas FBM KLCI diperluas kepada 50 kaunter - CIMB Securities | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 8 Sept — Sektor teknologi dan perindustrian berpotensi meraih banyak perhatian pelabur selepas indeks penanda aras FBM KLCI diperluas daripada 30 kepada 50 kaunter, serta mengurangkan dominasi sektor kewangan dan utiliti dalam indeks utama Bursa Malaysia, menurut CIMB Securities. Firma penyelidikan itu berkata pertambahan tersebut dijangka meningkatkan kepelbagaian sektor dengan memberikan bahagian perwakilan yang lebih besar kepada sektor perindustrian, teknologi, barangan pengguna pilihan, tenaga, hartanah dan barangan pengguna asas. Perubahan tersebut dilihat positif dari sudut struktur pasaran kerana FBM KLCI yang lebih pelbagai berpeluang menjadi penanda aras mencerminkan keseluruhan ekonomi Malaysia, selain meluaskan pilihan pendedahan pelabur institusi di luar kelompok syarikat bermodal besar sedia ada. "Simulasi terdahulu dilaksanakan kami menganggarkan 20 kaunter baharu itu boleh mewakili kira-kira 15.6% daripada FBM KLCI yang diperluaskan apabila penyertaan penuh dicapai," jelas CIMB Securities dalam nota analisisnya. Menurut firma berkenaan lagi, perluasan tersebut dijangka mengurangkan pemberat sektor kewangan dan utiliti, manakala sektor teknologi serta perindustrian antara segmen yang dilihat sebagai berpotensi mendapat perwakilan lebih besar dalam indeks berkenaan. Bagaimanapun ujarnya, impak aliran dana dalam tempoh terdekat dijangka lebih bersifat khusus kepada kaunter tertentu berbanding keseluruhan pasaran, memandangkan saiz aset di bawah pengurusan pasif yang menjejaki FBM KLCI masih relatif kecil. Kesan tersebut juga kata CIMB Securities, tidak akan berlaku secara mendadak kerana kemasukan kaunter baharu bakal dilaksanakan secara berperingkat, iaitu kira-kira 50% pada Disember 2026 sebelum mencapai penyertaan penuh 100% pada Jun 2027. "Pihak pengurusan FTSE sendiri sudah menjelaskan bahawa permodalan pasaran penuh akan digunakan bagi menentukan pemilihan akhir kaunter, manakala kaedah 'free float' atau pengapungan bebas akan menentukan pemberat setiap saham dalam indeks," tambahnya. Dalam perkembangan berkaitan, FBM70 akan dikurangkan kepada 50 kaunter dan dinamakan semula sebagai FBM Mid Cap Index mulai 21 Disember 2026, sementara FBM100 masih lagi dikekalkan tanpa sebarang perubahan jumlah kaunter didagangkan. Spesifikasi derivatif juga jelas CIMB Securities, adalahtidak berubah, manakala FTSE Russell sedang mengkaji kemungkinan untuk melonggarkan ambang kemasukan pantas bagi tawaran awam permulaan (IPO) yang bermodal saiz besar. Justeru, firma penyelidikan tersebut menjangkakan butiran lanjut mengenai perubahan struktur itu akan dimasukkan dalam kemas kini 'FTSE Bursa Malaysia Index Series Ground Rules' selepas dimuktamadkan pada akhir September 2026. Secara keseluruhan, ia kekal positif kerana perluasan itu berpotensi menjadikan FBM KLCI lebih pelbagai, sekali gus memberi ruang lebih besar kepada sektor teknologi dan industri dalam penanda aras utama pasaran saham Malaysia.

title: 'Mandat Pengurus Keselamatan Kebakaran Bomba bagi 9,451 Bangunan Tonjolkan Permintaan Pematuhan untuk Unique Fire
body: 'Langkah Malaysia menjadikan pemilik bangunan bertanggungjawab secara langsung terhadap keselamatan kebakaran dijangka meluaskan pasaran pematuhan bagi pembekal perlindungan kebakaran, sekali gus meletakkan Unique Fire Holdings Berhad (“Unique Fire”) antara syarikat yang berpotensi mendapat manfaat. Mulai 1 April 2027, pemilik 9,451 bangunan yang ditetapkan di bawah Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba akan diwajibkan melantik Pengurus Keselamatan Kebakaran (FSM) dan Pegawai Keselamatan Kebakaran (FSO), serta menubuhkan Organisasi Keselamatan Kebakaran (OKK) di premis masing-masing. Ketua Pengarah Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia (JBPM), Datuk Seri Nor Hisham Mohammad berkata, keperluan itu selaras dengan Seksyen 27A Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba (Pindaan) 2025. Menurut beliau, mana-mana bangunan yang diperiksa dalam tempoh satu hingga dua tahun akan datang dan diwajibkan memiliki Perakuan Bomba perlu melaksanakan struktur baharu tersebut. Beliau berkata demikian selepas melancarkan program FSM dan FSO di Menara Merdeka Maybank, Kuala Lumpur pada 6 Oktober 2026, di mana kumpulan pertama seramai 174 FSM dan 324 FSO menerima sijil masing-masing. Perubahan utama melibatkan kaedah pembaharuan Perakuan Bomba. Selepas ini, JBPM akan menilai laporan pemeriksaan tahunan yang disediakan oleh FSM bagi tujuan pembaharuan perakuan, tanpa perlu menjalankan pemeriksaan fizikal ke atas setiap bangunan setiap tahun. JBPM kini mempunyai 13 penyedia latihan berdaftar dan telah mengeluarkan tender bagi menambah bilangan penyedia latihan serta jurulatih. Tanggungjawab pematuhan beralih kepada pemilik bangunan Rangka kerja ini memindahkan tanggungjawab keselamatan kebakaran harian daripada pihak berkuasa kepada pemilik bangunan dan kakitangan dalaman mereka yang bertauliah. Di bawah program ini, FSM menjalani kursus lima hari merangkumi pemeriksaan bangunan, perancangan pemindahan, pelaporan dan penyelenggaraan, manakala FSO menjalani kursus teknikal selama tiga hari. Dengan FSM bertanggungjawab ke atas laporan tahunan yang menjadi asas pembaharuan Perakuan Bomba, pemilik bangunan dijangka memberi penekanan lebih besar untuk memastikan alat pemadam api, gelung hos, pili bomba, sistem pemercik, peranti pengesan dan penggera serta sistem pemadaman kebakaran sentiasa berfungsi dengan baik. Ini menunjukkan permintaan yang lebih stabil bagi penggantian, penyelenggaraan dan pengisian semula peralatan di seluruh 9,451 premis yang ditetapkan, termasuk bangunan berpenghuni tinggi dan berisiko tinggi. Unique Fire, yang ditubuhkan pada 1997 dan beribu pejabat di Shah Alam, Selangor, terlibat dalam pemasangan, pembuatan dan pengedaran sistem, peralatan dan aksesori perlindungan kebakaran aktif untuk persekitaran terbina. Rangkaian produknya merangkumi alat pemadam api mudah alih, gelung hos, sistem pili bomba dan pemercik, sistem paip naik basah dan kering, peranti pengesan dan penggera kebakaran, serta sistem pemadaman kebakaran termasuk sistem kimia basah dan karbon dioksida. 'Langkah Malaysia menjadikan pemilik bangunan bertanggungjawab secara langsung terhadap keselamatan kebakaran dijangka meluaskan pasaran pematuhan bagi pembekal perlindungan kebakaran, sekali gus meletakkan Unique Fire Holdings Berhad (“Unique Fire”) antara syarikat yang berpotensi mendapat manfaat. title: 'Axis REIT ‘well positioned’ against rate risks amid RM250 mil deal pipeline — analyst
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): Longer-term financing secured much earlier is now providing Axis REIT (KL:AXREIT) cushion against rising interest rates as the real estate investment trust pursues deals, an analyst said. A 25-basis-point increase in policy rate would potentially raise its cost of borrowings by just 0.1 percentage-point to 4.06%, Maybank Investment Bank said, noting that Axis REIT has locked in 10-year and seven-year financing facilities over the past 12 months when rates were more favourable. “With the completion of signed acquisitions, gearing is expected to rise to around 39%, still having ample headroom before any equity raising is required,” the research house said. Axis REIT owns and manages more than 70 office and industrial assets worth over RM5 billion in Klang Valley, Penang, Johor, Pahang, Negeri Sembilan and Kedah. The trust is in the midst of acquiring a distribution centre, a warehouse, and an industrial complex for RM193 million combined. The stated aim is to nearly double the asset under management to RM10 billion by 2030, driven by high-growth sectors and key industrial hubs throughout Peninsular Malaysia. In the near term, Axis REIT has a RM250 million acquisition pipeline currently under negotiation, of which one or two transactions could be announced before year-end, Maybank Investment said and maintained its “buy” call on the trust. “We believe its acquisition pipeline should provide further income visibility” with most ongoing transactions fully occupied and carrying weighted average lease expiry of five years or longer, the research house said. Axis REIT has rebounded from its September lows when the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years, sending global bond yields higher and triggering concerns of rising borrowing costs. Still, 10 out of 12 research houses tracked by Bloomberg recommend investors to “buy” Axis REIT and two are on “hold” calls. The average target price is RM2.22, a potential gain of up to 21% in the next 12 months from current price of RM1.84.

title: 'Haze keeps air quality unhealthy across most of S'pore as smoke drifts from Indonesia; Will haze affect the S'pore F1 Grand Prix? No race-day forecast yet from weatherman: Singapore live news
body: 'Haze keeps air quality unhealthy across most of S'pore as smoke drifts from Indonesia; Will haze affect the S'pore F1 Grand Prix? No race-day forecast yet from weatherman: Singapore live news A curated selection of some of the biggest, most important, and fascinating news that's making waves online, featured by Yahoo Singapore Air quality in four of Singapore's five regions remained unhealthy early on Tuesday (6 Oct), with the 24-hour PSI at 6am reaching 130 in the central region, 117 in the west, 112 in the east and 107 in the north, while only the south stayed moderate at 95, according to reports. One-hour PM2.5 levels were elevated in the central, west and east regions but normal in the north and south, following a worsening on Monday evening when the east joined the west and central regions in the unhealthy band. The National Environment Agency (NEA) forecast a 24-hour PSI in the "high moderate to mid unhealthy" range as south-easterly winds carry moderate to dense smoke from Kalimantan and southern Sumatra towards Singapore. NEA advises healthy people to reduce prolonged or strenuous outdoor exertion while the PSI is unhealthy, with the elderly, pregnant women and children told to minimise it and people with chronic heart or lung disease told to avoid it. The PSI first breached the unhealthy threshold on 4 Sept, the first haze-driven breach since October 2023, and peaked at a 2026 high of 164 in central Singapore on 29 Sept. The Meteorological Service Singapore (MSS) said a strong El Niño could delay the end of the dry season, with the monsoon transition expected only in late October or early November. Political, business and cryptocurrency leaders, including Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, investor Ray Dalio and Eric Trump, are gathering in hazy Singapore for finance conferences ahead of this weekend's Formula One Grand Prix. Hotel rates have soared, with the Fullerton Bay Hotel beside the track charging S$5,030 a night for a room that usually costs US$1,460, as hundreds of thousands of fans and about 90,000 top executives arrive, according to reports. Maybank economist Chua Hak Bin expects F1 to generate S$160 million in tourism receipts this year, up from the usual S$145 million, while the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) said the events showed strong momentum despite economic and geopolitical uncertainty, Reuters reported. Slumping bond prices and cooling sentiment on artificial intelligence are expected to dominate the Forbes CEO Conference and the Milken Asia Summit, while a crypto event is nearly sold out even after the market's value fell about a quarter in a year. Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA) forecast "high moderate to mid unhealthy" air for Tuesday (6 Oct) but gave no forecast for Sunday's race, and weather analyst Fergus Keatinge said there was no clear sign the haze would end quickly. Indonesia recorded 15,461 hotspots in September, second only to 2015, as a strong El Niño fuelled fires that left Singapore the world's third-most polluted city on 30 Sept. Read more in our live blog below, including the latest local and international news and updates. - Joel Balbin Smoky Singapore gears up to talk money ahead of F1 as haze shrouds city Political, business, cryptocurrency and sports leaders are gathering in Singapore for a series of finance-focused conferences ahead of this weekend's Formula One Grand Prix, as haze from Indonesian fires continues to cover the city-state. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, investor Ray Dalio and Eric Trump, co-founder of his family's cryptocurrency business, are expected to attend, along with hundreds of thousands of F1 fans, according to Reuters. The Fullerton Bay Hotel beside the race track is charging S$5,030 (US$3,933) a night for a room that usually costs US$1,460, as the night race and about 40 sideline events draw visitors. F1 generates about S$145 million a year in incremental tourism receipts, according to official estimates, and Maybank economist Chua Hak Bin expects that to reach S$160 million this year, plus broader gains from deals struck at sideline events, Reuters reported. The Singapore Tourism Board (STB) said F1 and its related events had strong momentum, reflecting confidence despite economic and geopolitical uncertainty. About 90,000 top-ranking executives are expected in town. Slumping bond prices and a shift in sentiment on artificial intelligence, from euphoric to cautious, are expected to occupy investors at the Forbes CEO Conference and the Milken Asia Summit, which begins on Wednesday (7 Oct). The total value of the cryptocurrency market has fallen about a quarter over 12 months to US$3 trillion, yet organisers of a crypto event said it was nearly sold out, with 25,000 attendees expected, matching last year, according to Reuters. Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA) forecast air quality in the "high moderate to mid unhealthy" range for Tuesday but gave no longer-range forecast for Sunday's race. Fergus Keatinge, director of WeatherMapping.com, said air quality would vary daily with wind and showers, but there was "no clear sign of a sustained pattern change" to end the haze quickly, according to Bloomberg. Kuala Lumpur topped IQAir's global pollution rankings on 30 Sept, with Singapore third, and poor air quality had forced organisers to shorten a Singapore half marathon at the last minute the previous weekend. Indonesia's forestry ministry recorded 15,461 hotspots in September, above 2019 levels and second only to 2015, as a strong El Niño brought abnormally hot and dry conditions. - Joel Balbin Air quality unhealthy as smoke drifts from Indonesia into Singapore amid haze Air quality in four of Singapore's five regions stayed in the unhealthy range early on Tuesday (6 Oct), with the 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) at 6am reading 130 in the central region, 117 in the west, 112 in the east and 107 in the north. Only the south, at 95, remained in the moderate band, where a reading of 101 to 200 is classed as unhealthy, Straits Times reported. One-hour PM2.5 readings, which guide immediate activities, were elevated in the central (60), west (59) and east (56) regions, while the north (48) and south (35) stayed at normal levels, according to Straits Times. The morning readings followed a deterioration on Monday evening, when the east reached a PSI of 101 at 6pm to join the west at 120 and the central region at 122 in the unhealthy band, with PM2.5 elevated in all five regions. The National Environment Agency (NEA) said in its 5 Oct advisory that with winds expected from the south-east or east-south-east, the 24-hour PSI was forecast to be in the "high moderate to mid unhealthy" range. Dry conditions are expected to persist over Kalimantan and southern Sumatra, where moderate to dense smoke plumes were seen drifting towards Singapore. Under NEA guidance, healthy people should reduce prolonged or strenuous outdoor exertion when the 24-hour PSI is unhealthy, while the elderly, pregnant women and children should minimise it and people with chronic heart or lung disease should avoid it. When PM2.5 is elevated, healthy people are advised to cut strenuous outdoor activity for the next hour, and vulnerable groups should avoid it. The PSI first crossed into the unhealthy range on 4 Sept, the first haze-driven breach since October 2023, and the year's highest reading of 164 was recorded in central Singapore on 29 Sept. The Meteorological Service Singapore (MSS) told the media that strong El Niño events tend to delay the end of the dry season, and that it expects Singapore's monsoon transition only in late October or early November, later than in the previous two years. title: '默迪卡118发展完成 PNB放眼经常收入达6亿 | e南洋
body: '（吉隆坡5日讯）国民投资机构（PNB）子公司PNB Merdeka Ventures私人有限公司（PNBMV）预计，随着默迪卡118（Merdeka 118）发展项目完成，中期每年可取得约5亿至6亿令吉的经常性收入。 根据大马评级机构MARC点出，默迪卡118办公楼约70%的空间已转租。PNBMV已将办公楼整体以“三重净租赁”方式出租予母公司PNB，因此可降低办公楼空置率及大部分房地产相关成本风险。 默迪卡118办公楼拥有约160万平方尺净可出租面积，其中约40%，即33层，已转租予马银行（MAYBANK，1155，主板金融股），约20%出租予PNB，另约10%出租予其他租户。 MARC预计，办公楼出租率未来5年可提高至约90%，每年净房地产收入料达1亿3700万令吉。 与此同时，MARC已确认PNBMV总值60亿令吉的默迪卡伊斯兰债券获AAAIS评级，展望稳定。 该评级与PNB的AAA／稳定企业信用评级一致，主要受到PNB提供无条件及不可撤销滚动担保的支持，以弥补伊斯兰债券本金及利润支付的任何短缺。 至于预计下月开业的7层楼零售商场，目前已有或正在洽谈的租赁协议覆盖约81%的75万324平方尺净可出租面积，指示性平均租金为每平方尺11.92令吉。 值得注意的是，马银行已正式进驻默迪卡118，而这座吉隆坡地标也已易名为“马银行默迪卡大楼”（Menara Merdeka Maybank）。

'默迪卡118发展完成 PNB放眼经常收入达6亿 | e南洋

'（吉隆坡5日讯）国民投资机构（PNB）子公司PNB Merdeka Ventures私人有限公司（PNBMV）预计，随着默迪卡118（Merdeka 118）发展项目完成，中期每年可取得约5亿至6亿令吉的经常性收入。 根据大马评级机构MARC点出，默迪卡118办公楼约70%的空间已转租。PNBMV已将办公楼整体以“三重净租赁”方式出租予母公司PNB，因此可降低办公楼空置率及大部分房地产相关成本风险。 默迪卡118办公楼拥有约160万平方尺净可出租面积，其中约40%，即33层，已转租予马银行（MAYBANK，1155，主板金融股），约20%出租予PNB，另约10%出租予其他租户。 MARC预计，办公楼出租率未来5年可提高至约90%，每年净房地产收入料达1亿3700万令吉。 与此同时，MARC已确认PNBMV总值60亿令吉的默迪卡伊斯兰债券获AAAIS评级，展望稳定。 该评级与PNB的AAA／稳定企业信用评级一致，主要受到PNB提供无条件及不可撤销滚动担保的支持，以弥补伊斯兰债券本金及利润支付的任何短缺。 至于预计下月开业的7层楼零售商场，目前已有或正在洽谈的租赁协议覆盖约81%的75万324平方尺净可出租面积，指示性平均租金为每平方尺11.92令吉。 值得注意的是，马银行已正式进驻默迪卡118，而这座吉隆坡地标也已易名为“马银行默迪卡大楼”（Menara Merdeka Maybank）。

title: 'Hilang Sumber Pendapatan Sejak Suami Sakit, Ibu Anak Empat Niaga Dalam Bonet Kereta Demi Sesuap Nasi
body: 'Diuji suami sakit secara tiba-tiba kerana sakit buah pinggang tahap empat dan kanser limfoma, ibu anak empat ini tetap gigih berdiri di bawah payung kecil yang dipacak di tepi bonet kereta demi mencari sesuap nasi dan selesaikan komitmen bulanan. Hilang Sumber Pendapatan Sejak Suami Sakit Kalau sebelum ini suaminya bekerja sebagai pemandu lori, sekarang hanya mampu duduk di atas kerusi dan terbaring di katil. Sesekali dia akan ulang-alik ke hospital untuk rawatan sakitnya. Dari beratnya 78kg, susut kepada 54kg disebabkan hilang selera makan. Beban mencari rezeki dan mengurus rumah tangga kini tergalas di atas bahu Puan Norin Sah binti Md Rejab selepas suaminya, Shaiful Bahari bin Muhamad Saad, 50, hanya terlantar di atas katil sejak disahkan menghidap penyakit kanser limfoma sejak bulan Januari tahun 2025. Ibu Anak Empat Niaga Dalam Bonet Kereta Demi Sesuap Nasi Setiap kali pelajar sekolah keluar dari pintu pagar, setiap kali itu lah wajah wanita berusia 44 tahun ini akan tersenyum dek kerana akan ada rezekinya masuk apabila jualan aiskrim Malaysia dan buah potongnya dibeli. Nampak kecil tetapi nilainya cukup besar bagi ibu yang gigih mencari rezeki demi anak-anak tersayang. Ibu kepada empat anak itu berkata, sejak suaminya disahkan menghidap kanser, kehidupan keluarganya berubah apabila suaminya tidak lagi dapat bekerja seperti sebelum ini. Tidak berharap lebih, tetapi cukuplah jika dapat bantu selesaikan apa yang patut dan suapkan anak-anak dengan rezeki yang halal. “Saya sendiri buntu memikirkan di mana hendak mencari duit selepas ini kerana perlu membuat bayaran macam-macam. Jual Makanan dalam bonet kereta tidak lah dapat banyak mana. tapi alhamdulillah, lepas lah buat beli lauk” katanya. Apabila keluar berniaga, Puan Norin atau lebih mesra dipanggil Kak Sya terpaksa tinggal suaminya di rumah sekejap. Dari segi sumbangan, ada dapat sedikit daripada kejiranan dan kebajikan sekitar taman. Orang ramai yang berhasrat membantu meringankan beban Kak Sya, boleh terus memberikan sumbangan menerusi nombor akaun ini: Anda mungkin berminat dengan Maybank: 152116003190 Nama: Norin Sah binti Md Rejab Nilainya tak banyak tak mengapa, yang penting ikhlas untuk meringankan beban ibu ini. Semoga dengan sedikit pemberian kita hari ini dapat membuatkan wajah seseorang yang diuji kembali tersenyum dan rasa masih ada harapan untuk melangkah ke depan. title: 'PNB unit eyes up to RM600mil recurring annual income from Merdeka 118
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: PNB Merdeka Ventures Sdn Bhd expects recurring income from the completed Merdeka 118 development to reach RM500 million-RM600 million a year over the medium term. About 70 per cent of the project's office space is already sub-leased, according to MARC Ratings. The firm said the office component is fully leased to parent Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB) under a triple-net master lease. This shields PNB Merdeka from occupancy and most property-related cost risks. MARC said about 70 per cent of the tower's 1.6 million sq ft net lettable area (NLA) has been sub-leased. This comprises 40 per cent, or 33 floors, sub-leased to Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank), 20 per cent to PNB and about 10 per cent to other tenants. Occupancy is expected to rise to about 90 per cent over the next five years, with the office tower projected to generate annual net property income of about RM137 million. MARC has affirmed its AAAIS rating on PNB Merdeka's RM6 billion Merdeka sukuk Wakalah with a stable outlook. The rating aligns with PNB's AAA/Stable corporate credit rating, supported by PNB's unconditional and irrevocable rolling guarantee covering any shortfall in principal and profit payments under the sukuk. MARC said for the seven-storey retail mall, which is expected to open next month, lease agreements covering 81 per cent of its 750,324 sq ft NLA have either been signed or are under negotiation, at an indicative average rental of RM11.92 per sq ft. The Merdeka 118 development, near Stadium Merdeka and Stadium Negara, has incurred RM10.6 billion in development costs to date. The cost was largely funded by two earlier sukuk programmes that have since been restructured into the current rated issuance. The planned residential components are expected to add another RM1.4 billion in development costs, to be funded through a mix of borrowings and equity injections. Two residential towers, with a combined estimated gross development value (GDV) of RM2 billion, are targeted for launch in the first half of 2027, while a serviced apartment project has an estimated GDV of RM745 million. MARC said these residential and serviced apartment components remain exposed to demand risk amid competing developments in Kuala Lumpur. PNB Merdeka is wholly owned by PNB and was established to undertake the Merdeka 118 project. This includes the 118-storey Menara Merdeka Maybank, a 17-floor luxury hotel, a three-floor observation deck and the upcoming retail mall. PNB Merdeka is also the landowner and custodian of Stadium Merdeka and Stadium Negara, both designated National Heritage sites.

title: '马股闭市微升0.88点 银行股撑大局 - 财经 - 即时财经
body: '马股闭市微升0.88点 银行股撑大局 （吉隆坡5日讯）部分银行股和消费股趁低吸纳，抵销杨忠礼双雄走软的冲击，富时综指周一开高走高，最终全日微升0.88点。  富时综指周一上半天曾升至1640.46点，上扬9.59点，随后回吐涨幅，午休上升1.84点，至1632.71点。 午盘之后虽然守住升势，但尾盘几乎回吐涨幅，最终微升0.88点，以1631.75点挂收。不过，全场下跌股超过上升股，有598只下跌股、564只上升股，另有524只平盘。 30只综指成分股中，有14只上升、13只下跌和3只没有起落。上涨的综指股包括国际船务(MISC,3816,主板交通物流组)起17仙，至7令吉70仙；99迷你超市(99SMART,5326,主板消费产品服务组)起6仙，至3令吉12仙。 部分银行股走稳，收盘时，丰隆银行(HLBANK,5819,主板金融服务组)涨24仙，收报22令吉88仙；大马银行(AMBANK,1015,主板金融服务组)起11仙，收于6令吉50仙；联昌集团(CIMB,1023,主板金融服务组)涨8仙，收报7令吉73仙；大众银行(PBBANK,1295,主板金融服务组)起5仙，至4令吉71仙。不过，马来亚银行(MAYBANK,1155,主板金融服务组)则下挫2仙，至10令吉。 另一边厢，杨忠礼电力(YTLPOWR,6742,主板公用事业组)下跌14仙，收于5令吉54仙；杨忠礼机构(YTL,4677,主板公用事业组)降8仙，至2令吉16仙。 反映大盘走势的富时全股指数上升19.78点，至12190.35点，创业板指数也涨77.15点，收报5606.61点。 其他马股指数普遍上涨，科技指数上涨1.74%，为全场最出色，另外，建筑指数则下跌1.46%，是全场最差。 全场成交量达到47亿8168万1200股，总值28亿8516万8841令吉。 全球股市方面，美国非农就业数据低于预期，降低联储局加息的概率，亚洲股市全面上涨，收盘时，台湾加权指数急升2.55%：日本日经指数大涨2.40%，菲律宾马尼拉综指上扬2.03%；印尼雅加达综指起1.36%，新加坡、泰国和香港股市也上涨少于1%。 韩国和中国股市今天休市。 美元指数回升，马币兑美元和新元周一双双走低。 根据《彭博社》行情，马币兑美元全日游走于4.0778至4.0885，截至下午5时报4.0875，低于上周五的4.0820；马币兑新元全日在3.1865至3.1950之间徘徊，截至下午5时挂3.1941，上周五收于3.1922。 大豆油价格上涨，带动大马衍生产品交易所12月指标期货上涨28令吉，至每公吨4563令吉。  热门新闻 百格视频

'马股闭市微升0.88点 银行股撑大局 （吉隆坡5日讯）部分银行股和消费股趁低吸纳，抵销杨忠礼双雄走软的冲击，富时综指周一开高走高，最终全日微升0.88点。  富时综指周一上半天曾升至1640.46点，上扬9.59点，随后回吐涨幅，午休上升1.84点，至1632.71点。 午盘之后虽然守住升势，但尾盘几乎回吐涨幅，最终微升0.88点，以1631.75点挂收。不过，全场下跌股超过上升股，有598只下跌股、564只上升股，另有524只平盘。 30只综指成分股中，有14只上升、13只下跌和3只没有起落。上涨的综指股包括国际船务(MISC,3816,主板交通物流组)起17仙，至7令吉70仙；99迷你超市(99SMART,5326,主板消费产品服务组)起6仙，至3令吉12仙。 部分银行股走稳，收盘时，丰隆银行(HLBANK,5819,主板金融服务组)涨24仙，收报22令吉88仙；大马银行(AMBANK,1015,主板金融服务组)起11仙，收于6令吉50仙；联昌集团(CIMB,1023,主板金融服务组)涨8仙，收报7令吉73仙；大众银行(PBBANK,1295,主板金融服务组)起5仙，至4令吉71仙。不过，马来亚银行(MAYBANK,1155,主板金融服务组)则下挫2仙，至10令吉。 另一边厢，杨忠礼电力(YTLPOWR,6742,主板公用事业组)下跌14仙，收于5令吉54仙；杨忠礼机构(YTL,4677,主板公用事业组)降8仙，至2令吉16仙。 反映大盘走势的富时全股指数上升19.78点，至12190.35点，创业板指数也涨77.15点，收报5606.61点。 其他马股指数普遍上涨，科技指数上涨1.74%，为全场最出色，另外，建筑指数则下跌1.46%，是全场最差。 全场成交量达到47亿8168万1200股，总值28亿8516万8841令吉。 全球股市方面，美国非农就业数据低于预期，降低联储局加息的概率，亚洲股市全面上涨，收盘时，台湾加权指数急升2.55%：日本日经指数大涨2.40%，菲律宾马尼拉综指上扬2.03%；印尼雅加达综指起1.36%，新加坡、泰国和香港股市也上涨少于1%。 韩国和中国股市今天休市。 美元指数回升，马币兑美元和新元周一双双走低。 根据《彭博社》行情，马币兑美元全日游走于4.0778至4.0885，截至下午5时报4.0875，低于上周五的4.0820；马币兑新元全日在3.1865至3.1950之间徘徊，截至下午5时挂3.1941，上周五收于3.1922。 大豆油价格上涨，带动大马衍生产品交易所12月指标期货上涨28令吉，至每公吨4563令吉。  热门新闻 百格视频

title: '市场人气低迷拖累，马股综指周一表现滞后，收盘微幅走高
body: '受地缘政治风险和通胀风险持续引发的担忧，以及股市人气低迷的拖累，马股综合指数周一表现滞后，未能跟上区域市场的乐观情绪，收盘仅微幅走高。 截至下午闭市，综合指数涨0.88点或0.05%，至1,631.75点。 市场整体表现平衡，全场上涨股564只，下跌股58只，524只平盘，另1063只股无交易。全天成交量47.81亿股，总成交额28.85亿令吉。 综指成分股涨跌互见，雀巢（NESTLE，4707，主板消费股）涨48仙至90.00令吉，马国际船务（MISC，3816，主板交通与物流股）涨17仙至7.70令吉，国油气体（PETGAS，6033，主板公用事业股）涨10仙至17.30令吉。 下跌股，吉隆坡甲洞（KLK，2445，主板种植股）跌14仙至20.86令吉，杨忠礼电力（YTLPOWR，6742，主板公用事业股）跌14仙至5.54令吉，金务大（GAMUDA，5398，主板建筑股）跌11仙至4.99令吉。 银行股，马银行（MAYBANK，1155）跌2仙至10.00令吉，大众银行（PBBANK，1295）涨5仙4.71令吉，联昌国际（CIMB，1023）涨8仙至7.73令吉，兴业银行（RHBBANK，1066）涨3仙至7.46令吉，丰隆银行（HLBANK，5819）涨24仙至22.88令吉，大马银行（AMBANK，1015）涨11仙至6.50令吉。 热门股方面，Zetrix AI（ZETRIX，0138，主板科技股）跌5仙至6.5仙，威铖（VS，6963，主板工业股）涨3仙至32仙，捷硕科技（JAKS，4723, 主板建筑股）跌1仙至17仙，力扬科技（EFORCE，0065，主板科技股）跌4仙至17仙，顶级手套（TOPGLOV，7113，主板保健股）涨2.5仙至78.5仙。 其他重要股项，马太平洋（MPI，3867，主板科技股）涨1.00令吉至43.40令吉，科艺集团（KGB，0151，主板工业股）涨49仙至9.12令吉；峇都加湾（BKAWAN，1899，主板种植股）跌1.48令吉至18.98令吉，联合种植（UTDPLT，2089，主板种植股）跌32仙至31.06令吉。 亚太主要股指，新加坡海峡时报指数起 0.52% 至 5,664.34 点，香港恒生指数起 0.28% 至 24,040.34 点，日本日经指255数起 2.40% 至 69,946.86 点。韩国开天节补假休市，中国股市则国庆长假期休市。

title: 'MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 Strengthens ASEAN Healthcare Cooperation
body: 'MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 is a healthcare cooperation between Cambodia and Malaysia, merging medicine with financial services and community health in Phnom Penh. The event was held on October 3 and 4 at Borey Peng Huoth Eco Park and was organized by Maybank Cambodia and the Malaysia Healthcare Travel Council. The move is part of a wider trend in ASEAN to make cross-border healthcare more accessible. The event showcased practical means of streamlining medical travel in the region by connecting Cambodian families with Malaysian healthcare providers and financial services. Malaysian Healthcare Expertise Reaches Cambodia The event gathered 14 leading Malaysian hospital groups and medical specialists in Phnom Penh. Cambodian families were able to have discussions with health professionals about preventive health care, specialty care and potential medical travel arrangements. This direct engagement can help patients to better understand treatment options before traveling overseas. It also builds linkages between the healthcare providers of both countries and raises greater awareness in the region of Malaysia’s medical services. Maybank Connects Healthcare With Financial Services Maybank Cambodia took the opportunity to showcase cross border payment solutions, medical travel privileges and financial planning support at the event. These services are intended to help families overcome some of the financial and administrative barriers to arranging treatment overseas. The addition of banking support with access to healthcare provides a more rounded medical travel experience. For patients considering treatment in Malaysia, planning for finances can be an important part of managing the transportation, hospital expenses and other associated costs. Community Wellness Takes Center Stage MH WellFest wasn’t just about medical travel, it was about preventive health and community participation. The MH WellFest Run added a public wellness aspect to the event with over 800 runners and walkers in the 5km and 10km categories. Visitors also could attend health screening booths, medical presentations and family-oriented cultural activities. These programs defined health cooperation as a community-based effort that involved prevention, education and healthier lifestyles. Powering ASEAN’s Next Big Shift Can AI Reshape ASEAN’s Power Grid? Check out how AI is complicating ASEAN’s regional energy ambitions. Is Singapore Leading Nuclear Acceptance? Find why Singapore is emerging as a regional nuclear energy leader. What Is AIME-2026 Really About? Uncover the key details behind India and ASEAN’s maritime exercise. Can ASEAN Balance Its Trade Future? Browse how India is pushing for a more balanced ASEAN trade pact. How Deep Are EU-ASEAN Trade Ties? See how new EU trade talks could strengthen economic relations. Supporting ASEAN Medical Tourism Goals The event was part of the wider Malaysia Year of Medical Tourism 2026 by the Malaysia Healthcare Travel Council. Malaysia has been marketing itself as a regional hub for international patients looking for specialized medical services. Regional medical tourism could bloom with stronger healthcare links to Cambodia and other ASEAN markets. Partnerships between hospitals, financial institutions and healthcare organizations could also help create a more connected ASEAN healthcare ecosystem. FAQs What is MH WellFest Cambodia 2026? MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 is a health and wellness care event that brings Cambodian and Malaysian medical communities together with financial communities. When and where did the event happen? MH WellFest Cambodia 2026 was held at Borey Peng Huoth Eco Park, Phnom Penh, Cambodia from 3rd to 4th October, 2026. How many hospital groups in Malaysia participate? The event was attended by 14 leading hospital groups and medical specialists in Malaysia.

title: 'MARC Ratings Affirms PNB Merdeka Ventures’ Sukuk Rating - MARC
body: 'MARC Ratings has affirmed the rating of AAAIS on PNB Merdeka Ventures Sdn Berhad’s (PNBMV) Merdeka Sukuk Wakalah Programme of up to RM6.0 billion with a stable outlook. The affirmed rating is equalised with the AAA/Stable corporate credit rating of Permodalan Nasional Berhad (PNB) which is based on publicly available information. The rating equalisation is premised on the unconditional and irrevocable rolling guarantee from PNB to cover any shortfall in principal repayments and profit payments on the Merdeka Sukuk Wakalah. PNBMV is wholly owned by PNB and was set up to undertake the 40-acre Merdeka 118 development in the vicinity of Stadium Merdeka and Stadium Negara in Kuala Lumpur. The development comprises several components, chiefly the 118-storey Menara Merdeka Maybank (formerly known as Menara Merdeka 118), a single tower with 84 floors of office space, a 17-floor luxury hotel and a three-floor observation deck. Adjacent to the tower are a seven-floor retail mall which is expected to open in November 2026, and sites earmarked for the future construction of two residential towers and a serviced apartment building. PNBMV is also the landowner and custodian of Stadium Merdeka and Stadium Negara, both of which are listed as National Heritage sites. PNBMV has leased the entire 84 floors of office space in the tower to PNB under a triple net master lease agreement. PNB undertakes all property-related expenses, including quit rent, insurance and repair costs, in addition to the monthly net rental and service charge. PNBMV is therefore not exposed to the occupancy risks or other risks associated with the office component of the tower. As at date, about 70% of the 1.6 million sq ft of net lettable area (NLA) of the office tower has been sub-leased: 40% or 33 floors to Maybank, 20% to PNB, and about 10% to other tenants. Occupancy is expected to increase to approximately 90% over the next five years. The office tower is expected to generate an annual net property income of around RM137.0 million. Lease agreements for 81% of the 750,324 sq ft of NLA in the retail mall have either been signed or are under negotiation to be signed with tenants at an indicative average rental rate of RM11.92/sq ft. Meanwhile, the two residential apartment buildings, with an estimated combined gross development value (GDV) of RM2.0 billion, are targeted to be launched in 1H2027. The serviced apartments, to be launched later, will have an estimated GDV of RM745 million. The residential apartment and serviced residence components are exposed to demand risk given competing developments in Kuala Lumpur. The Merdeka 118 development has so far incurred a development cost of RM10.6 billion, largely funded by two earlier sukuk programmes that have since been restructured into the current rated issuances. The upcoming residential projects are expected to add a further RM1.4 billion in development cost and will be funded through a mix of borrowings and equity injections. The rolling guarantee covers any shortfall for the periodic distribution and upcoming principal repayments throughout the entire sukuk programme through automatic renewal on each profit payment date. Upon completion of the entire project, cash flow generation from recurring income streams could amount to about RM500 million to RM600 million p.a. over the medium term.

title: 'UOB Malaysia, RHB Banking and Maybank execute landmark MYOR-based transaction
body: 'PETALING JAYA: UOB Malaysia, RHB Banking Group and Malayan Banking (Maybank) recently executed the first Malaysia Overnight Rate-based three-month interbank money market transaction in the country, incorporating a two-day lookback calculation convention through an interbank money market broker.   The landmark transaction was anchored by UOB Malaysia and executed with RHB and Maybank, marking a significant milestone in the evolution of Malaysia’s money market and supporting industry efforts towards the adoption of risk-free rate-based market conventions.

title: 'Player fatigue threatens TNB campaign as MHL resumes
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: The second round of the Malaysian Hockey League (MHL) begins on Monday, and it has caused havoc for league leaders Tenaga Nasional (TNB) and their season campaign. TNB will face the Armed Forces on Wednesday at the National Hockey Stadium in Bukit Jalil but 11 of their players will only be arriving on Monday from the Asian Games. Malaysia were defeated 5-1 by defending champions India in the Asiad final in Nagoya on Saturday. The first round of MHL ended on May 17 with TNB leading the standings on 19 points from six wins and a draw, followed by Maybank and Terengganu Hockey Team with 17 and 14 points respectively. TNB coach Madzli Ikmar said the 11 national players would be tired after playing three consecutive tournaments at the Nations Cup in South Africa in June, the World Cup in Belgium in August and the Asian Games, which ended on Saturday. "The 11 players need a good rest after playing so many international matches. I have to use the other 12 players in the training squad in the MHL. "I am having a headache as I also need to use national players to play in the league to do well. I have decided that players who played a few matches in the Asian Games would play in the match against Armed Forces," said the former national captain Madzli. Madzli added that the other issue was that the national team would also feature in the six-nation Asian Champions Trophy in Punjab, India from Oct 27 to Nov 5. "Again, national players from TNB would be released to play in the tournament. I know that the priority is the national team, but if all 11 players feature in the tournament, then how are we going to play with the remaining 12 players in MHL? "I will leave it to the team management to decide whether they want to release national players for the tournament," said Madzli. The MHL will break on Nov 14 as the national team prepares for the Sultan Azlan Shah Cup in Ipoh from Nov 22-29 before the national league resumes for the knockout stage on Dec 2.

title: 'PMCK Expands Beyond Hospitals as Maybank Maintains BUY With RM0.35 Target Price
body: 'PMCK Bhd is entering a new phase of growth as the healthcare group expands beyond its core hospital operations into the medical consumables business. Maybank Investment Bank remains positive on the company, maintaining its BUY recommendation with an unchanged target price of RM0.35, compared with PMCK’s share price of RM0.195 in the report, implying potential upside of about 79%. A major highlight is PMCK’s proposed RM52.8 million acquisition of Marpoliq Sdn Bhd and Derberg Sdn Bhd, two medical consumables suppliers. The acquisition will broaden PMCK’s healthcare ecosystem from hospital services into sourcing and distribution of disposable medical devices, respiratory and airway products, feeding supplies, incontinence pads and other hospital and home-care accessories. Completion is targeted by 1Q27. Maybank views the deal positively because medical consumables provide recurring and higher-margin income while giving PMCK exposure to both government and private hospitals. Importantly, the acquisition comes with a RM3 million annual profit-after-tax guarantee for FY27E and FY28E. The deal is valued at just 7.2x P/E and 4.9x EV/EBITDA, significantly below the average valuations of Bursa-listed medical supply peers. The earnings impact could also be meaningful. Maybank estimates the acquisitions could increase PMCK’s FY27E core net profit from RM13.0 million to RM16.8 million, representing a 29.4% uplift after accounting for the acquired companies’ earnings contribution and additional interest expenses. Both businesses also enjoy stronger profitability, with FY26 PAT margins of 21.6% for Marpoliq and 29.1% for Derberg, compared with PMCK’s existing margin of around 12%. Beyond the acquisition, PMCK has an established healthcare footprint in northern Malaysia. It has operated PMC Alor Setar since 1995, while Kedah and Perlis remain relatively underserved in terms of private hospital beds. Another major catalyst is the upcoming 90-bed PMC Kulim hospital, targeted for 1QCY28, which should expand capacity and increase patient throughput. Looking ahead, Maybank forecasts PMCK’s revenue rising from RM107.1 million in FY27E to RM207.2 million in FY29E, while core net profit is projected to increase from RM13.6 million to RM19.8 million. With hospital expansion, growing patient volumes and the move into higher-margin medical consumables, PMCK is building multiple growth engines that could strengthen its longer-term earnings profile.

title: 'IOI Marina View secures financing
body: 'SINGAPORE: IOI Marina View, a real estate developer, has secured an Islamic term financing facility worth SG$1.73 billion (US$1.35 billion) from DBS Bank, Maybank Singapore, OCBC and UOB, according to Allen & Gledhill, which acted as the transaction counsel to the banks. The facility will be used to finance IOI Marina View’s acquisition of investment holding company MVKimi.

title: 'Restock Sambal Nyet Bilis, Khairul Aming Sekali Lagi Capai ‘Sales’ RM2 Juta
body: 'Sekilas  Khairul Aming berjaya mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta untuk produk terbaharunya, Sambal Nyet Bilis. Beliau berkongsi pencapaian tersebut di Threads dengan memaparkan angka jualan RM2,181,558.73 sambil mengucapkan terima kasih kepada peminat. Jualan produk ini sebelum ini juga pernah mencapai RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit semasa pelancaran di Menara Merdeka Maybank.  Pempengaruh dan usahawan, Khairul Aming sekali lagi mencatatkan pencapaian membanggakan apabila mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta menerusi penjualan produk terbaharunya iaitu Sambal Nyet Bilis.  Menerusi perkongsian di Threads, Khairul Aming berkongsi foto dirinya sambil memegang komputer riba yang memaparkan angka sebanyak RM2,181,558.73.  Malah, anak jati Kelantan ini turut meluahkan rasa syukur selepas jualan tersebut berjaya mencapai angka yang memberangsangkan.  “Alhamdulillah kita capai jualan 2 juta ringgit untuk restock Sambal Bilis tadi  “Terima kasih guys,”kongsinya.  Perkongsian itu kemudiannya meraih perhatian ramai yang rata-ratanya menzahirkan ucapan tahniah buat Khairul Aming.  Sebelum ini, Khairul Aming mencatat jualan RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit bagi produk terbaharunya itu melalui platform TikTok ketika pelancaran produk berkenaan di Menara Merdeka Maybank (sebelum ini dikenali sebagai Merdeka 118).

title: '《走在路上》Helen''s Kitchen招牌海南鸡扒   炸鱼排才是新惊喜光华日报 | 1910年创刊 创新每一天生活
body: 'Helen”s Kitchen 的炸鱼排 Fish and Chips，的确好吃，绝不输给它家的招牌 Chicken Chop（海南鸡扒）。 古有孟母三迁、今有老板“两年五搬”。经过5次搬迁后，没想到这次的炸鱼排反而像获得“神助攻”，比以前更好吃。难怪老板一直叫我一定要试试 Fish and Chips。 当然，海南鸡扒依然是熟悉的味道，外脆内嫩再配上传统海南式茄汁，简单、就是好吃。 说回炸鱼排，鱼肉鲜嫩、不腥，炸衣薄脆、不会厚厚一层粉，入口香脆，鱼肉的鲜味也吃得出来。尤其趁热吃，一口接一口、还真的停不了。 我个人更喜欢抹上浓郁的塔塔酱，Creamy的口感，鱼香、酱香一起入口，满口都是香。 - Advertisement - 除了招牌西餐，Helen”s Kitchen 还有炸鱼肉或大虾青冬炎，以及红豆冰、煎蕊两款甜品都做得很好。 老板说，因为摊档空间不大，目前就先卖这几样，往后可能还会再增加几道拿手好菜。 Helen”s Kitchen 其实并没有“躲”起来，只是一说破就知道……它就在丹绒武雅著名路边炸香蕉糕，“上面”的咖啡店里。 从坡底上来，过了MayBank再转进左边的BARAKATH 扁担饭，看过去对面的咖啡店内就是。 若还是找不到？地址直接给你： 1-0-8, Jalan Chan Siew Teong, Tanjung Bungah, 11200 George Town, Pulau Pinang。 营业时间：上午9时30分至下午5时，逢周二休息。 - Advertisement - › 立即申请 - GMBB Part Timer - Event - Kuala Lumpur - MYR 110.00 /Month › 立即申请
